review_kind: source inspection after author revisions; test execution owned by integration task

findings.issue: Native fallback errors were all classified as callbacks; legitimate failed linear solves terminated adaptive integration instead of permitting a smaller trial.
findings.resolution: The raw dispatcher marks solver-origin retryable failures only after a guarded callback layer proves no callback error was returned; the adaptive driver records failure work then shrinks h.

findings.issue: A public output session could accept an endpoint without matching a previously issued trial.
findings.resolution: Session retains its pending trial, verifies exact represented endpoint/clipped flag and dimension, and delegates finite/overshoot validation before committing.

findings.issue: Compact receipts could be mistaken for fixed-memory integration.
findings.resolution: Documented O(max_attempts) receipt storage; every failure and fallback remains retained.

findings.issue: Native linear-solver failure classification could be counted as nonlinear failure after normalization to RootIteration.
findings.resolution: RawStepAttempt.retry_failure_kind preserves AdaptiveFailureKind::LinearSolve/NonlinearSolve/NonFinite from trusted solver-origin failures; adaptive counters use that field.

findings.issue: Raw-U stages must not pass through native-K finish_step; new block LU must not inherit old bit-identity claims.
findings.resolution: Raw workspace output/embedded mapping retained; notes separate targets and arithmetic paths.

checked_contracts.detail: Candidate and new fallback use b_code output and final raw stage as embedded vector; historical native-K fallback remains separate.
Physical t/y advance after output accept; rejected trials do not record accepted fallback history.
Coupled Frozen is new each attempt; raw fallback always fresh; dimension checked; epoch change checked; guarded callbacks detect partial/nonfinite output.
Candidate, fallback, and extra full-space validation work are merged before any failure branch; trusted solver failure category is retained for aggregate counters.
Strict-lower norm recurrence matches raw stage differences; caller inverse/Lipschitz/tube assumptions and floating-point noncertification are explicit.
Repeated diagonal and zero upper blocks checked; one diagonal LU plus forward solves; full projected linear residual checked.
No eight-stage vectors retained in trajectory receipts, but receipt storage grows with max_attempts; kernel and output storage remain additional.

production_conclusion: No broad-production promotion follows from source review or conditional f64 estimates alone.

execution_observations.observation: Initial integration-owned run: 4 block-solve unit tests passed; 8 adaptive tests passed; singular-retry fixture failed its preliminary exact gamma*rate equality before solver execution. Author notified; preserve this original log and record the corrected fixture rerun separately.

additional_runtime_finding.problem: native fallback counter omitted JVP callback that returned Err
additional_runtime_finding.correction: guarded callback boundary attempted/completed counts replace overlapping counters; compact receipt preserves completed counts without double charging
additional_runtime_finding.regression: raw_step_contracts external AtomicU64 count equality on both successful and failed paths
